summary.text: Lynn DeCoite represents District 7 in the Hawaii State Senate and took office on June 17, 2021.

paragraphs.text: She previously represented District 13 in the Hawaii House of Representatives from 2015 to 2021.

She was born in Honolulu, worked as a sweet potato farmer and co-owned L&R Farms Enterprises, LLC, and served on the boards of Lokahi Pacific, Hikiola Cooperative and the Molokai Irrigation Advisory Board.
